verdict.first_step_1: Search Homebrew for available Postgres versions with brew search postgresql@ and install the newest major version (using postgresql@18).
verdict.first_step_2: Install Postgres directly using brew install postgresql@17.
verdict.reason: Reply 2 uses a currently available Postgres formula and a standard self-signed certificate, whereas Reply 1 uses a non-existent version (postgresql@18) that will fail to install and unnecessarily overcomplicates setup with a custom Certificate Authority.
